text: LIR S.r.l., an investment holding company belonging entirely to Mario Moretti Polegato (85%) and Enrico Moretti Polegato (15%), holds 71.16% of Geox S.p.A.; Geox's half-year 2026 report names Diadora S.p.A. among the group's affiliated companies.
short: Diadora is an affiliated company of the Geox group, controlled by the Polegato family's LIR S.r.l.

source.name: Geox S.p.A. – Half-Year Financial Report 30 June 2026 (related parties)
source.quote: The Group has dealings with the ultimate parent company (LIR S.r.l.), with affiliated companies (mainly Diadora S.p.A. for the portion related to revenues on royalties

additionalSources.name: Wikipedia – Geox
additionalSources.quote: In 2009, Geox agreed with Italian sportswear company Diadora to have Polegato buy its assets through his family's investment arm, LIR.
